# openobserve_stream (Resource)

Manages an OpenObserve stream and its settings: retention, partitioning, indexing, and schema options.

Applying this resource to a stream name that does not exist yet creates it. Applying it to a stream that already exists (because data has been ingested into it) adopts the stream and manages its settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openobserve_stream" "app_logs" {
  name        = "app_logs"
  stream_type = "logs"

  data_retention  = 30
  max_query_range = 168

  full_text_search_keys = ["message", "error"]
  index_fields          = ["level"]
  bloom_filter_fields   = ["trace_id"]

  # A field used as a partition key cannot also be a secondary index field.
  partition_keys = [
    { field = "service", type = "value" },
  ]
}

# A stream that keeps only a defined set of columns, with the rest folded into
# the catch-all field. Useful for high-cardinality sources.
resource "openobserve_stream" "metrics" {
  name        = "app_metrics"
  stream_type = "metrics"

  data_retention        = 90
  defined_schema_fields = ["service", "instance", "region"]
  store_original_data   = true

  partition_keys = [
    { field = "instance", type = "hash", hash_buckets = 16 },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stream name.
- `stream_type` (String) Stream type: `logs`, `metrics`, `traces`, or `metadata`.

### Optional

- `approx_partition` (Boolean) Use approximate partitioning for faster ingestion.
- `bloom_filter_fields` (Set of String) Fields with bloom filter acceleration.
- `data_retention` (Number) Retention period in days. `0` inherits the cluster-wide default.
- `defined_schema_fields` (Set of String) Fields kept in the user-defined schema. Other fields move to the catch-all column.
- `distinct_value_fields` (Set of String) Fields whose distinct values are tracked. Requires `enable_distinct_fields`.
- `enable_distinct_fields` (Boolean) Track distinct values for the fields listed in `distinct_value_fields`.
- `enable_log_patterns_extraction` (Boolean) Extract log patterns from ingested records.
- `flatten_level` (Number) How many levels deep nested JSON is flattened on ingestion.
- `full_text_search_keys` (Set of String) Fields included in full-text search.
- `index_all_values` (Boolean) Index every field value rather than only the configured index fields.
- `index_fields` (Set of String) Fields with a secondary index for fast filtering.
- `index_original_data` (Boolean) Include the original document in the full-text index.
- `max_query_range` (Number) Maximum query time range in hours. `0` means unlimited.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.
- `partition_keys` (Attributes List) Partition keys used for data layout and query pruning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--partition_keys))
- `store_original_data` (Boolean) Keep the original unflattened document alongside the parsed one.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID in the format `{org_id}/{stream_type}/{name}`.
- `schema` (Attributes List) Columns discovered in the stream, as reported by the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema))
- `storage_type` (String) Storage tier reported by the server.

<a id="nestedatt--partition_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `partition_keys`

Required:

- `field` (String) Field used as the partition key.

Optional:

- `hash_buckets` (Number) Number of buckets when `type` is `hash`.
- `type` (String) Partitioning strategy: `value` (default), `prefix`, or `hash`.

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Boolean) True when the partition key has been retired but is retained for old data.


<a id="nestedatt--schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schema`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Field name.
- `type` (String) Field data type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Streams are imported as {org_id}/{stream_type}/{name}.
terraform import openobserve_stream.app_logs default/logs/app_logs
```
